title: Back-end data safety
description: For a change to services, data stores or jobs: idempotent retries, invariants enforced by the database, reversible migrations and object-level authorization.

rules.instruction: Make operations that clients or jobs retry idempotent, or require an idempotency key, so that a repeated request does not repeat its effect.
rules.verification: Check the test that sends the same request twice and asserts a single effect.

rules.instruction: Enforce uniqueness, references and required values with database constraints in addition to application checks.
rules.verification: Read the migration or schema for the constraints that back each invariant of the change.

rules.instruction: Split schema changes into expand, migrate and contract steps so that the previous application version keeps working during rollout, and time them on a production-sized copy.
rules.verification: Check that the migration plan lists the steps, the timing measured and the rollback for each.

rules.instruction: Check on each endpoint that takes an object identifier that the caller may access that object and the fields returned or changed.
rules.verification: Check the tests that call each changed endpoint with another user's object identifier and expect a refusal.
